package errs

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"go/ast"
	"go/parser"
	"go/token"
	"math"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	perrors "github.com/pingcap/errors"
	"go.uber.org/zap/zapcore"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
)

func TestNativeCompleteErrorOracle(t *testing.T) {
	type row struct {
		Name    string `json:"name"`
		Code    string `json:"code"`
		Message string `json:"message"`
		Display string `json:"display"`
		Wrapped string `json:"wrapped"`
		ByCause string `json:"by_cause"`
	}
	definitions := []struct {
		name  string
		value error
	}{
		{"ErrUnmatchedClusterID", ErrUnmatchedClusterID},
		{"ErrFailInitClusterID", ErrFailInitClusterID},
		{"ErrClosing", ErrClosing},
		{"ErrTSOLength", ErrTSOLength},
		{"ErrNoServiceModeReturned", ErrNoServiceModeReturned},
		{"ErrClientGetProtoClient", ErrClientGetProtoClient},
		{"ErrClientGetMetaStorageClient", ErrClientGetMetaStorageClient},
		{"ErrClientCreateTSOStream", ErrClientCreateTSOStream},
		{"ErrClientTSOStreamClosed", ErrClientTSOStreamClosed},
		{"ErrClientGetTSO", ErrClientGetTSO},
		{"ErrClientGetMinTSO", ErrClientGetMinTSO},
		{"ErrClientGetLeader", ErrClientGetLeader},
		{"ErrClientGetMember", ErrClientGetMember},
		{"ErrClientGetClusterInfo", ErrClientGetClusterInfo},
		{"ErrClientUpdateMember", ErrClientUpdateMember},
		{"ErrClientNoAvailableMember", ErrClientNoAvailableMember},
		{"ErrClientNoTargetMember", ErrClientNoTargetMember},
		{"ErrClientProtoUnmarshal", ErrClientProtoUnmarshal},
		{"ErrClientGetMultiResponse", ErrClientGetMultiResponse},
		{"ErrClientGetServingEndpoint", ErrClientGetServingEndpoint},
		{"ErrClientFindGroupByKeyspaceID", ErrClientFindGroupByKeyspaceID},
		{"ErrClientWatchGCSafePointV2Stream", ErrClientWatchGCSafePointV2Stream},
		{"ErrCircuitBreakerOpen", ErrCircuitBreakerOpen},
		{"ErrClientRouterConnectionTimeout", ErrClientRouterConnectionTimeout},
		{"ErrSecurityConfig", ErrSecurityConfig},
		{"ErrTLSConfig", ErrTLSConfig},
		{"ErrURLParse", ErrURLParse},
		{"ErrGRPCDial", ErrGRPCDial},
		{"ErrCloseGRPCConn", ErrCloseGRPCConn},
		{"ErrCryptoX509KeyPair", ErrCryptoX509KeyPair},
		{"ErrCryptoAppendCertsFromPEM", ErrCryptoAppendCertsFromPEM},
		{"ErrClientListResourceGroup", ErrClientListResourceGroup},
		{"ErrClientResourceGroupConfigUnavailable", ErrClientResourceGroupConfigUnavailable},
		{"ErrClientResourceGroupThrottled", ErrClientResourceGroupThrottled},
		{"ErrClientPutResourceGroupMismatchKeyspaceID", ErrClientPutResourceGroupMismatchKeyspaceID},
		{"ErrSchedulerConfigUnavailable", ErrSchedulerConfigUnavailable},
	}
	// Fail when an upstream error definition is added without an oracle entry.
	file, err := parser.ParseFile(token.NewFileSet(), "errno.go", nil, 0)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	names := map[string]bool{}
	for _, decl := range file.Decls {
		if gen, ok := decl.(*ast.GenDecl); ok && gen.Tok == token.VAR {
			for _, spec := range gen.Specs {
				for _, name := range spec.(*ast.ValueSpec).Names {
					names[name.Name] = true
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if len(names) != len(definitions) {
		t.Fatalf("definition coverage %d != %d", len(names), len(definitions))
	}
	rows := []row{}
	cause := errors.New("underlying")
	for _, definition := range definitions {
		if !names[definition.name] {
			t.Fatal(definition.name)
		}
		delete(names, definition.name)
		value := row{Name: definition.name, Display: definition.value.Error(), Message: definition.value.Error()}
		if normalized, ok := definition.value.(*perrors.Error); ok {
			value.Code = string(normalized.RFCCode())
			value.Message = normalized.MessageTemplate()
			wrapped := normalized.Wrap(cause)
			if errors.Unwrap(wrapped) != cause {
				t.Fatal("cause lost")
			}
			value.Wrapped = wrapped.Error()
			value.ByCause = wrapped.GenWithStackByCause().Error()
			if normalized.Wrap(nil) != nil {
				t.Fatal("nil wrap")
			}
			if !errors.Is(normalized.FastGenByArgs(), normalized) {
				t.Fatal("code identity")
			}
		}
		rows = append(rows, value)
	}
	checks := map[string]bool{
		"nil_leader":         IsLeaderChange(nil),
		"direct_stream":      IsLeaderChange(ErrClientTSOStreamClosed),
		"stack_stream":       IsLeaderChange(perrors.WithStack(ErrClientTSOStreamClosed)),
		"generated_stream":   IsLeaderChange(ErrClientTSOStreamClosed.FastGenByArgs()),
		"wrapped_stream":     IsLeaderChange(ErrClientTSOStreamClosed.Wrap(cause)),
		"fake_stream":        IsLeaderChange(errors.New(ErrClientTSOStreamClosed.Error())),
		"wrapped_not_leader": IsLeaderChange(perrors.Annotate(errors.New("server is not leader now"), "RPC")),
		"nil_callee":         IsCalleeMismatch(nil),
		"callee":             IsCalleeMismatch(errors.New("server mismatch callee id")),
		"wrong_case":         IsCalleeMismatch(errors.New("Mismatch callee id")),
	}
	for _, message := range []string{NoLeaderErr, NotLeaderErr, NotServedErr, NotPrimaryErr, RetryTimeoutErr, MismatchCalleeIDErr} {
		checks["leader_"+message] = IsLeaderChange(errors.New("before " + message + " after"))
	}
	networks := []bool{}
	for code := codes.OK; code <= codes.Unauthenticated; code++ {
		networks = append(networks, IsNetworkError(code))
	}
	logs := map[string]any{}
	addLog := func(name string, e error, causes ...error) {
		field := ZapError(e, causes...)
		encoder := zapcore.NewMapObjectEncoder()
		field.AddTo(encoder)
		// Stack/verbose diagnostics are runtime-specific. Preserve the actual error
		// interface separately; all basic field text is compared with Rust.
		logs[name] = encoder.Fields["error"]
	}
	addLog("nil", nil, cause)
	addLog("prototype", ErrClientGetTSO)
	addLog("wrapped", ErrClientGetTSO, cause, errors.New("ignored"))
	addLog("nil_cause", ErrClientGetTSO, nil)
	addLog("foreign", cause, errors.New("ignored"))
	generated := ErrClientGetTSO.FastGenByArgs("original")
	field := ZapError(generated, cause)
	if field.Interface != generated {
		t.Fatal("generated error replaced")
	}
	addLog("generated", generated, cause)
	addLog("static", ErrClosing, cause)
	resource := []string{}
	for _, e := range []*ErrClientGetResourceGroup{
		{}, {ResourceGroupName: "group"}, {ResourceGroupName: "group", Err: cause},
		{ResourceGroupName: "group", Cause: "explicit", Err: cause},
		{ResourceGroupName: "group", Err: errors.New("")},
	} {
		resource = append(resource, e.Error())
		if errors.Unwrap(e) != e.Err {
			t.Fatal("resource cause lost")
		}
	}
	formatted := []string{
		ErrClientCreateTSOStream.FastGenByArgs("input").Error(),
		ErrClientGetTSO.FastGenByArgs("input").Error(),
		ErrClientGetMinTSO.FastGenByArgs("input").Error(),
		ErrClientGetLeader.FastGenByArgs("input").Error(),
		ErrClientUpdateMember.FastGenByArgs("input").Error(),
		ErrClientGetMultiResponse.FastGenByArgs("input").Error(),
		ErrSecurityConfig.FastGenByArgs("input").Error(),
		ErrClientListResourceGroup.FastGenByArgs("input").Error(),
		ErrClientResourceGroupConfigUnavailable.FastGenByArgs("input").Error(),
		ErrSchedulerConfigUnavailable.FastGenByArgs("input").Error(),
		ErrClientResourceGroupThrottled.FastGenByArgs("25ms", 1.125, -2.5).Error(),
		ErrClientResourceGroupThrottled.FastGenByArgs("25ms", math.Inf(1), math.Inf(-1)).Error(),
		ErrClientResourceGroupThrottled.FastGenByArgs("25ms", math.NaN(), math.Copysign(0, -1)).Error(),
		ErrClientPutResourceGroupMismatchKeyspaceID.FastGenByArgs(uint32(0), uint32(math.MaxUint32)).Error(),
	}
	output := map[string]any{"definitions": rows, "classifiers": checks, "network_codes": networks, "logging": logs, "resource_group": resource, "formatted": formatted}
	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(output, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if dir := os.Getenv("PD_ERRS_ORACLE"); dir != "" {
		if err = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "errors.json"), append(data, '\n'), 0644); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
}
